item.title: Adding SSH Key Login and Troubleshooting
item.description: 1. Steps to Add a Key 1.1 Generate an SSH Key on the Client There are two key formats: Old format, the private key begins with -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- 1 ssh-keygen -m PEM -t rsa -b 4096 -C "mail@chenshaowen.com" New format, the private key begins with -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY----- 1 ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "mail@chenshaowen.

item.title: Telnet and SSH Principles
item.description: This article mainly introduces the communication principles of Telnet and SSH, and analyzes their working flow during communication. 1. Telnet No matter what type of terminal a Telnet protocol connection uses, communication is converted to NVT (Net Virtual Terminal) format. The Network Virtual Terminal, NVT, is the foundation of Telnet’s heterogeneous, cross-platform nature.
